title: Keystroke — The fastest way to build internal agents and AI systems
excerpt: Keystroke gives teams everything they need to build powerful agents and AI systems in a single platform.
content_html:
Keystroke gives teams everything they need to build extremely powerful agents and AI systems, all in a single platform.

Use cases

Build AI agents

Give agents memory, a persistent workspace, and the tools they need to take on real work.

Build AI systems

Combine agents, workflows, triggers, and human approval to automate complex work reliably.

Build your company brain

Give every team one place to collaborate and share context, agents, and skills.

Build your first agent

Built for technical and non-technical teams

Build with

What Keystroke handles for you

  • Agents
  • Orchestration
  • Integrations
  • Collaboration
  • Control
